rationale: The candidate accurately and sufficiently describes the preserved implementation. `command.go:831-850` shows that `SuggestionsFor` considers only `cmd.IsAvailableCommand()`, appends `cmd.Name()` when `ld(typedName, cmd.Name(), true) <= c.SuggestionsMinimumDistance` or when the lowercased command name starts with the lowercased typed name, and also appends it for a case-insensitive match against any `cmd.SuggestFor` entry. `command.go:1495-1503` supports the statement that `Name()` is the first word of `Use`. `command.go:750-765` supports disabling suggestions, defaulting a nonpositive threshold to 2, and formatting nonempty results under `Did you mean this?`. All required claims are grounded in the bundle.
